institute.name: Charters Union of Business
institute.overview: Charters Union of Business (also referred to as Charters Business College) is an industry-led educational institution focused on providing high-impact, experiential learning. Our approach is designed to bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world corporate requirements, preparing students for leadership roles in a global business environment.

core_pillars.title: Industry-Led Education
core_pillars.description: Programs designed with direct input from industry leaders, CEOs, and Fortune 500 partners.

core_pillars.title: Experiential Learning
core_pillars.description: Hands-on experience through live corporate projects, internships, and real-world case studies (including Harvard Business School and global business cases).

core_pillars.title: Global Exposure
core_pillars.description: Global presence and immersion opportunities across India, United States, Canada, Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Singapore.

core_pillars.title: Mentorship Network
core_pillars.description: 100+ active mentors including Ivy League professors, top C-Suite executives, and industry veterans.

programs.name: Certified Business Accountant (CBA™ / MBA)
programs.focus: AI-Powered Global Business Accounting, Corporate Finance, Auditing & Valuation
programs.eligibility: 12th / Undergraduates / Graduates (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, B.Tech, etc.) or early career professionals

fees.success_fee: Structured success fee model based on placement

highlights: Curriculum built on USCMA, ACCA, ICAI standards & Harvard Business case studies
100% Paid Internship in top global companies across 7 countries
1:1 Mentorship from top 1% CA/CMA/CFA & Industry Leaders

programs.name: Digital Growth & Marketing (DGM™ / PGDM)
programs.focus: Performance Marketing, Growth Hacking, AI Marketing Automations & Product Analytics
programs.eligibility: Graduates from any discipline / final-year students / working professionals
highlights: Live budget management for real ad campaigns
AI automation workflows for multi-channel growth
Direct placement assistance with high-growth startups and MNCs

programs.name: Technology & Business Management (TBM™ / Executive)
programs.format: Weekend Classes + Online (Designed for Working Professionals)
programs.focus: Product Growth Engineering, Strategic Tech Leadership, AI Transformation
highlights: Learn without interrupting your current job
Executive networking with C-Suite leaders and Silicon Valley founders
Hands-on AI and product roadmapping sprints

admission_process.title: Online Application
admission_process.description: Fill out the simple application form on our website with basic educational details.

admission_process.title: AI-Powered Aptitude Assessment
admission_process.description: Complete a quick online evaluation testing problem-solving, cognitive ability, and career intent.

admission_process.title: Industry Leader Interview
admission_process.description: Engage in a 1:1 conversation with a senior industry mentor or admissions panel member.
